small_guidance:
- Sweep BLOCK_SP at 8 and add num_warps=1 configs; POW=16 so BLOCK_SP=16 already covers a full row in one tile — smaller warps may reduce occupancy waste.
- Try storing weights in shared/constant via tl.load once outside the ic loop is already static; consider reordering loops so ic is the innermost (better weight reuse) or precomputing per-(kd,kh,kw) parity offsets as host-side constants passed as constexpr.
- Add channels_last (NDHWC) layout for x and weight so the IC dimension is contiguous and loads coalesce across the K reduction.
large_guidance:
- Tile over OC and pooled-spatial together as a small GEMM: BLOCK_OC=16 (full OC) × BLOCK_SP along pooled width, but reshape the reduction K = IC*KD*KH*KW = 81 and use tl.dot on a [BLOCK_SP, K] × [K, BLOCK_OC] matmul after gathering input values with im2col-style indexing. This lets tensor cores accelerate the inner product.
- Alternatively, since stride=2 makes only one od per kd contribute to a given pool position, restructure the kernel so each program produces the full pool window's 8 contributions in one pass — gather input once per ic and reuse across (kd,kh,kw) parities.
